criteria.evidence: finish (tailoring.ts:146-195) takes lockUser first (155), flips RUNNING->SUCCEEDED and calls spendTailoringCredit (wallet.ts:159-176) in one transaction: free before purchased, one TAILORING -1 row with applicationId and tailoringId. The round-1 F1 hole is closed: begin and finish now serialize on the same advisory lock, so a start cannot read the wallet before a finish commits and the reserved rows after it. spend-per-tailoring.test.ts:345 plus the race case at :424. A 40-round local stress run (12 concurrent starts and 2 pollers per user, instant model) on Postgres 16 gave 120 successes, every one with exactly one ledger row and one credit spent, and no deadlock or error in the server log.

The FAILED branch returns before any spend (tailoring.ts:174). reconcileInterrupted only flips status, and the reservation is derived from RUNNING reserved rows, so it is released. spend-per-tailoring.test.ts covers provider failure and other-boot interruption with the balance and ledger unchanged.

Lock order is the same everywhere: begin (withLiveUser, service.ts:46-47) and finish (tailoring.ts:155) both take pg_advisory_xact_lock(user) before any row lock. get() (tailoring.ts:361) row-locks without the advisory lock but takes no other lock, so no cycle exists. No callback under withLiveUser opens a second pool connection, so pool max 10 (db/service.ts:81) cannot starve. Race test :424 fails 5/5 on eea51770 sources (second POST 202, expected 402) and fails when only the lockUser line at :155 is deleted at head. At head it passes in about 540 ms through the hook's 500 ms fallback, because B blocks on the advisory lock A holds. That is the intended serialization, not luck.

When spendTailoringCredit returns false (wallet.ts:168), finish sets the same row back to FAILED/INTERRUPTED with result null in the same transaction (tailoring.ts:181-193). The SUCCEEDED+result state therefore never commits and get() cannot see it. The row stops counting as a reservation, recordLedger is skipped, and console.error logs the event. A user cannot reach this branch to get a free result. The only credit decrement in src is spendTailoringCredit. Purchases only add credits (purchases.ts:284). Reservations are serialized by the user lock. A job reconciled to FAILED by get or by another boot makes finish's guarded UPDATE (status = RUNNING) match nothing, so nothing is delivered. spend-per-tailoring.test.ts:502 proves it: FAILED, no result, one log line, no ledger row, wallet 0.
